name: Class Crush Crisis
original_name: เพื่อนสนิทระวังคิดไม่ซื่อ
overview: Lee-ith dreams of becoming a cool indie rock musician. Because of his complete disregard for his studies, his mother sends him to a new school, one that's accepting male students for the first time this year. He immediately clashes with studious Putter who ends up being his roommate.
